text:
Smells fishy, most every micro controller/chip vendor has minimum order quantities. 

Typically in the prototyping process you’ll work with a vendor that has those parts on hand to make you a prototype, or you contact individual suppliers for 1 off components at a GREATLY increased cost.

Call intel, and try to get 1 single USB4/TB4 IO controller

Call Texas Instruments and try to get 1 single USB4/TB4 DAC

Call Parade Technologies and try to get 1 single USB-C PD controller

Chinese suppliers have these parts on hand so they can make a prototype for you, it’s much harder to order parts for DIY assembly.

On top of that, only recently have machine shops like @sendcutsend started providing hobbyists with low quantity CNC parts for things like chasis/knobs
